# VotePulse full context
# Jersey 2026 general election intelligence

## About Jersey elections

Jersey holds general elections for the States Assembly, which includes Deputies, Connétables, and Senators. The 2026 election date is published by the States Assembly and official election channels — confirm on vote.je.
Jersey has 14 parishes, each returning Deputies. Connétables are the heads of each parish.

## About VotePulse

VotePulse was built to provide voters with structured, comparable information about candidates — something that did not exist for Jersey elections before 2026.

The platform uses AI to:

1. Summarise candidate manifestos in neutral language
2. Extract positions on 10 key policy issues
3. Classify news sentiment

All AI content is clearly labelled and linked to source text.

## District list

St Helier North, St Helier Central, St Helier South,
St Saviour, St Brelade, St Clement, St Peter,
St Lawrence, St Mary, St Ouen, St John,
Trinity, Grouville, St Martin

## Methodology

Data collection: public candidate pages and official sources (e.g. flow.je, vote.je, policy.je)
AI enrichment: structured JSON output with source quotes tied to manifesto text
Source verification: every AI claim should be checked against original manifesto text
Update cycle: on a regular cadence aligned with the scraper and enrichment pipeline (target: every 6 hours where sources allow)
